registration.question: Of the 555 embryonic terminal cells of the reference lineage, how many end with a terminal type, and the right one, in a program that contains none of the lookup's 555 fate_<cell> decisions?

tissue_E.cells: E's 34 terminal descendants, all Intestine in the reference
tissue_E.founder_decided_by: SKN-1 present and POP-1 absent (fate_E); POP-1 is absent in E only because EMS was polarised by MOM-2 read at the measured EMS-P2 contact (fate_EMS_polarised, div_EMS_polarised)
tissue_E.circular: yes, as a wild-type prediction: 'E's clone is intestine' is Sulston 1983's observation, the record the 555 are scored against

tissue_D.cells: D's 20 terminal descendants, all Muscle in the reference
tissue_D.founder_decided_by: the name D with PAL-1 present and SKN-1 absent, both segregated by named divisions (fate_D)
tissue_D.circular: yes, as a wild-type prediction: 'D's clone is body-wall muscle' is Sulston 1983's observation

tissue_germline.cells: P4's two daughters, Z3 (P4a) and Z2 (P4p), Reproductive in the reference
tissue_germline.founder_decided_by: the name P4 with PIE-1 present (germline)
tissue_germline.circular: yes, and it is also a translation of the program's GermCell into the reference's word for the germ line

what_moves_off_the_lookup.not_moved: every AB, MS and C terminal cell: none of those founders' clones is one tissue, and a rule naming a sub-founder would be the lookup under another name

definitions.denominator: the 555 embryonic terminal cells: reference cells that are terminal, do not die, and are born before 800 min (fate_rules.embryonic_terminal)
definitions.decided_without_the_lookup: a cell of the 555 whose cell_type at 800 min is one of the 17 terminal types, in a program in which no decision is fate_<cell> for any of the 555 (asserted before counting; the run is void otherwise)
definitions.right: that type equals the reference type; wrong otherwise
definitions.attribution: walking from the cell up its parents in the run, the first cell on which a differentiate decision to that type fired; every decided cell must be attributed to one of tissue_E, tissue_D, tissue_germline, or the run is void
definitions.primary_arm: embryo_nolookup.bio as committed, every timer at its mean, grown to 800 min

predictions.P2 seeds: the same 56 / 56 / 0 with the timers drawn, seeds 0 to 19, every seed
predictions.P3 founders: the eight founder types under the measured table are the expected ones: ABa ABaPrecursor, ABp ABpPrecursor, EMS EMSPolarised, MS MSPrecursor, E EPrecursor, C CPrecursor, D DPrecursor, P4 GermCell (8 of 8)
predictions.P4 other tables: the curated table (contacts_embryo.tsv) and the loosest measured reading (Sheet1, 3,011 detected pairs) give the same eight founder types and the same 56 / 56 / 0
predictions.P5 no table: with no contact table nothing is induced: ABp takes ABaPrecursor, E takes MSPrecursor, Intestine 0, decided 22 (tissue_D 20, tissue_germline 2), right 22
predictions.P6 rearranged: ABa and ABp swapped in the measured table alone: ABa takes ABpPrecursor and ABp takes ABaPrecursor
predictions.P7 knockouts, founder level: the eight knockouts of scripts/celegans_contacts.py give their published founder transformations under the measured table: 8 of 8
predictions.P8 knockouts, terminal level: Intestine / Muscle / Reproductive / decided among the 555 are POP-1 111/20/2/133, SKN-1 0/20/2/22, PIE-1 0/20/0/20, APX-1 and GLP-1 34/20/2/56 (as wild type), PAL-1 34/0/2/36, MOM-2 and MOM-5 0/20/2/22

P8 published terminal phenotype reproduc.PIE-1: False: 'no germ line' holds, 'extra intestine' does not (Intestine 0)
P8 published terminal phenotype reproduc.APX-1: not testable at the terminal level
P8 published terminal phenotype reproduc.GLP-1: not testable at the terminal level
P8 published terminal phenotype reproduc.MOM-5: True in direction; penetrance not compared

published_terminal_phenotypes.POP-1: MS adopts the E fate: extra intestine, no MS-derived pharynx or muscle (Lin, Thorpe & Priess 1995, Cell 83:599). Registered reading: reproduced in direction if MS's terminal cells are Intestine; the count (111) is NOT comparable, because MS's divisions are still read from the lineage by name, where a pop-1 MS makes an E-like lineage
published_terminal_phenotypes.SKN-1: no intestine and no pharynx; EMS daughters make C-like hypodermis and muscle (Bowerman et al. 1992, Cell 68:1061). Registered reading: reproduced if Intestine is 0; the extra C-like tissue is not decidable here (no C tissue rule)
published_terminal_phenotypes.PIE-1: P2 takes the EMS fate: extra pharynx and intestine and no germ line (Mello et al. 1992, Cell 70:163). Registered reading: 'no germ line' reproduced if Reproductive is 0; 'extra intestine' NOT reproduced, predicted in advance and in the opposite direction: the program loses E's intestine too, because presents_mom2 requires PIE-1 in P2, so without PIE-1 no Wnt reaches EMS at the contact and E takes the MS fate; and the MS/E founder rules are guarded on the names MS and E, so a P2 turned EMS-like still divides into cells named C and P3, and D keeps its muscle
published_terminal_phenotypes.APX-1: ABp becomes ABa-like (Mello et al. 1994, Cell 77:95). Registered reading: a founder-level phenotype only; no AB fate is decided without the lookup, so nothing terminal can move
published_terminal_phenotypes.GLP-1: ABp becomes ABa-like (Priess, Schnabel & Schnabel 1987, Cell 51:601). As APX-1
published_terminal_phenotypes.PAL-1: C and D lose their fates: no D muscle (Hunter & Kenyon 1996, Cell 87:217). Registered reading: reproduced if Muscle is 0; C's tissues are not decided either way
published_terminal_phenotypes.MOM-2: E takes the MS fate, no intestine (Thorpe et al. 1997, Cell 90:695; Rocheleau et al. 1997, Cell 90:707). Registered reading: reproduced if Intestine is 0
published_terminal_phenotypes.MOM-5: E takes the MS fate (Rocheleau et al. 1997). The published RNAi phenotype is partially penetrant; the program's knockout is complete, so only the direction is compared

what_is_circular: every one of the expected 56 wild-type fates: each founder-tissue rule was written from the clonal observation in the same Sulston lineage the fates are scored against
every founder-level knockout phenotype: the founder rules cite these same papers
the terminal-level knockout outcomes follow from those two circular rule sets; a pass is consistency, not prediction, and a fail is a limit of the rules

what is not circular: the contact topology itself (CShaper, a segmentation study made for another purpose), and so whether the measured contacts deliver the founder signals to the cells the genetics says they reach
void_if: V1 any of the 555 has a fate_<cell> decision in the program
V2 the primary arm does not grow the reference tree to 800 min: the reference cells born by 800 min must all be matched by name with no parent mismatch
V3 genomeos.organism.diff.compare counts a different number of correct terminal fates than this instrument's right count on the primary arm (two instruments disagree)
V4 a decided cell cannot be attributed to tissue_E, tissue_D or tissue_germline

falsifiers.measured contacts: any of the eight founder types differs under the measured table (P3): the measured geometry does not deliver the signals as the program writes them
falsifiers.contact dependence: P5 fails with E still Intestine: the 34 do not depend on a contact and that claim is withdrawn
falsifiers.count: P1 off: the founder rules do not carry the clones as written

wording.P1 holds: 56 of 555 embryonic terminal fates are decided without the lookup, 56 right and 0 wrong, in embryo_nolookup.bio; all 56 are circular as wild-type predictions (each founder-tissue rule was written from Sulston's clonal observation, the record they are scored against); 34 follow a Wnt read at a measured contact (Cao et al. 2020), 22 follow maternal factors segregated by named divisions. The shipped embryo_factors.bio is unchanged and its count stays 0
wording.P1 fails: N of 555 decided without the lookup, R right, W wrong; stated with which clone departs from the registered 34 / 20 / 2
wording.seeds vary: the count is reported as its range over seeds 0 to 19, and the primary number as the means run only

result_manifest.assembly: n/a: a cell lineage and per-cell factor presence; nothing is placed on a genome
result_manifest.coordinates: n/a: cells are named by their lineage path, not by a genomic interval
exclusions: terminal cells of AB, MS and C: no founder-tissue rule names them, so they are counted as not decided, never as wrong
post-embryonic cells: the 555 are those born before 800 min
result_manifest.partitions: n/a: no evaluation split; every cell is read

entry_script.why: argv[0] is a file inside this repository that git tracks and reports unmodified: the commit holds the code that wrote the bytes, so a rebuild can run it. The only clean form
entry_script.forms_are_decided_in_advance: genomeos.manifest.ENTRY_FORMS: one clean form (a tracked, unmodified file inside this repository), every other form refuses, and a form that cannot be classified is 'unknown' and refuses too. Read from sys.argv[0] at write time, never declared

code_cleanliness.counting_path_is_computed: the transitive import closure of this script, computed from the files' import statements at write time (genomeos.manifest.counting_path), never by importing: it follows every import that resolves to a file in this repository rather than only the package, counts the __init__.py of each package above a module, resolves bare imports against the directories the source literally puts on sys.path as well as the repository root, and matches every path component against what its directory lists, so a class name such as genomeos.genome.Genome cannot enter it as a file; not a hand-written list
code_cleanliness.note: several lanes work in this one checkout. A file under foreign_uncommitted_code belongs to another lane; this lane did not write it and did not commit it. The counting path is the computed closure above, so a foreign file outside it cannot have entered a number here, and foreign_uncommitted_code_on_the_counting_path names any that could

revision_stamps.sampled: code_cleanliness.git_sha is read while the writer computes; code.git_sha is read when the result is written. Both are HEAD of the same checkout at two moments
revision_stamps.reading: no revision race: both stamps record a3790d0

traced_inputs.note: Every file this writer opened for reading under data/ was recorded by an audit hook on the "open" event, canonicalised through data/'s links so one file has one spelling, and compared against the inputs the manifest declares; a member of a declared group counts as declared and hashed on its own, a file under a declared directory counts as declared by prefix. The hook is per interpreter, so a file read by a subprocess is not in this record, nor is one reached through a path that canonicalises to neither this checkout's data/ nor one of its link targets.
